decisions.executionNote: Establish elbow-up approaches: left toward toy vehicles, right toward cameras. Keep grippers open and inspect alignment before descending.
Continue above the left yellow vehicle and right central camera, progressively pitching grippers downward with elbow-up continuity.
Advance to center the yellow vehicle and camera between the jaws, descend conservatively, then close. Retention remains unconfirmed until lifting.
Lift both closed grippers to verify retention, then start toward white for vehicles and red for cameras, keeping objects above basket rims.
Right camera is retained; carry it into red basket. Left vehicle slipped, so reopen and reapproach slightly lower and nearer its center.
Close around the lower-centered yellow vehicle and test lift. Lower and release the retained camera inside red, then clear the basket.
Yellow vehicle is visibly retained. Raise and carry it toward white basket; move empty right gripper toward the small camera nearer the center.
Place and release the yellow vehicle farther inside white. Descend onto the center-right camera, close and lift briefly to check grasp.
Forward reach was interrupted; release the vehicle at its current position over white, then retreat. Complete a smaller vertical camera grasp with the right arm.
Vehicle has released into white. Retreat left with smaller increments after the continuity rejection. Close and lift the aligned camera to verify retention.
Carry the retained second camera to red. Approach the blue vehicle from above with a slight yaw to match its diagonal body.
Center and close on the blue taxi, then test lift. Release the second camera into red and begin retreating toward the remaining rightmost camera.
Blue taxi is retained; lift and transport to white while preserving clearance. Align the right gripper with the diagonal last camera and approach from above.
Release blue taxi inside white and withdraw toward the final gold car. Make a small centering correction on the rightmost camera, close, and lift to check retention.
Third camera is visibly held; transport it over red while keeping it elevated. Move left above the final gold vehicle for a close visual alignment.
Center and grasp the gold vehicle, checking by a short lift. Release the last camera in red and retract right toward the remaining pen while turning to match it.
Gold vehicle was not retained; reopen, approach lower with a small forward correction, and retry. Bring right gripper above the pen and complete its orientation alignment.
Gold vehicle appears pinched; lift and carry left toward white while watching retention. Descend onto the aligned pen barrel, close, then test lift.
Carry the retained gold car fully over white and release. Lift the pen to confirm retention and start toward blue, keeping the right arm on its side.
All three vehicles appear inside white and cameras inside red. The pen remained on the table; reopen right and retry lower. Align left gripper along the black pen for the remaining category.
Descend to the thin pen barrels with a small left lateral correction. Close at a lower height than the failed right attempt; verify visually before transporting.
Allow both grippers to finish closing, then lift straight upward slowly to test whether the thin pens are retained.
Both pens are visibly retained after lifting. Carry the black pen toward blue first; hold the right pen away from the center to keep the arms separated.
Replan after left continuity rejection: ease backward and turn the retained black pen lengthwise toward the blue basket, using smaller translations to maintain elbow-up continuity.
Advance the black pen slowly farther inside blue while lowering and straightening it, then release. Hold the other pen stationary to avoid arm interference.
Reach guard stopped the final advance; black pen is already over blue. Release at the observed pose and retreat in small increments. Rotate the retained right pen lengthwise for its placement.
Clear the left arm from blue and begin returning it home. Carry the retained gold-trimmed pen over the right half of blue, aligned lengthwise and above the rim.
Lower the retained pen farther inside blue with a slight diagonal orientation and gentler wrist pitch to avoid overreach. Continue the empty left arm toward its origin.
Release the final pen inside blue, pause for separation, then withdraw right. Finish the left arm's gradual return to its original pose with the gripper open.
Both pens are released in blue, with vehicles in white and cameras in red. Withdraw the empty right arm toward origin without crossing the left arm; allow objects to settle.
Complete the right arm's gradual return to its original pose, keeping both grippers open. Objects appear grouped by category and settled in their respective baskets.
